name: AI Image Expand
description: Enlarge the canvas and the model paints in the new border (outpainting). Uses MI-GAN, a 28 MB inpainting model, so it is fast on CPU. Your original pixels are never altered. The result must be accepted before it is saved as a derivative.
author: Pigeon
source: MI-GAN (Picsart AI Research, ICCV 2023), ONNX pipeline export
privacy: Only the model file is downloaded, once. Images are processed locally and never sent anywhere.
